46800.meaning1: bunch of flowers; handful of flowers; bouquet of blossoms

examples.text: so araññato āgacchante mālākāre disvā thokaṃ thokaṃ phāṇitakhaṇḍaṃ datvā uḷuṅkena pānīyaṃ adāsi, te c'assa ek'ekaṃ pupphamuṭṭhiṃ adaṃsu.

46803.meaning1: heap of flowers; pile of blossoms

examples.text: yathā'pi puppharāsimhā, kayirā mālāguṇe bahū, evaṃ jātena maccena, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ bahuṃ.

46806.meaning2: Chapter 10 of the Khandhasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 3 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

46809.commentary: (VINa) pupph'aṃsā uppajjī'ti pupphaṃ assā uppajji, akāralopena sandhi.

46811.commentary: (VINa) pupph'āsavo nāma madhukapupph'ādīnaṃ rasena kato. (VINt) madhuka-tāla-nāḷiker'ādi-puppharaso ciraparivāsito pupph'āsavo.

examples.text: merayo nāma pupph'āsavo phal'āsavo madhv'āsavo guḷ'āsavo sambhārasaṃyutto.
sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena andhavanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami divāvihārāya. andhavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ supupphitasālarukkhamūle aṭṭhāsi.
daharā ca apāpikā c'asi, kiṃ te pabbajjā karissati, nikkhipa kāsāyacīvaraṃ, ehi ramāmase pupphite vane.

46819.synonym: pubbaka, pubbatara, purāṇa, purima, purimaka, porāṇa

examples.text: anamataggo'yaṃ, bhikkhave, saṃsāro. pubbā koṭi nappaññāyati sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ
vītataṇho purā bhedā, pubbam'antam'anissito, vemajjhe n'upasaṅkheyyo, tassa n'atthi purakkhataṃ.
sūriyassa bhikkhave udayato etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ yadidaṃ aruṇ'uggaṃ
manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce pasannena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ sukham'anveti, chāyā'va anapāyinī
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbakoṭṭhake
406, 429. atha pubbāni vibhattīnaṃ cha parassapadāni.
pubbam'adhoṭhitam'assaraṃ sarena viyojaye'ti

46823.meaning1: (gram) initial vowel; preceding letter; first syllable

examples.text: 459, 462. pubbo'bbhāso.
sare lutte pubbo ca kvaci dīghaṃ yāti.

46824.commentary: (VISM) pubbo'ti pūtilohitavasena pavattapubbaṃ. taṃ vaṇṇato paṇḍupalāsavaṇṇo. matasarīre pana pūtibahal'ācāmavaṇṇo hoti. saṇṭhānato okāsasaṇṭhāno.

examples.text: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā āpodhātu.
kālena kālañ'ca vaṇaṃ dhoveyyāsi, kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpeyyāsi, mā te na kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhovato na kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpato pubbalohitaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ pariyonandhi.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso araññe pavane caramāno passeyya purāṇaṃ maggaṃ purāṇ'añjasaṃ pubbakehi manussehi anuyātaṃ.
saritvā pubbake yogī, tesaṃ vattam'anussaraṃ, kiñ'c'āpi pacchimo kālo, phuseyya amataṃ padaṃ.
aññataro naṭapubbako bhikkhu evam'āha, sabbo'yaṃ maññe saṅgho sītīkato'ti.

46827.meaning1: (gram) in front; coming first; preceded by

examples.text: 319, 330. upasagganipātapubbako abyayībhāvo.
atha sabbāsaṃ vibhattīnaṃ yāni yāni pubbakāni cha padāni, tāni tāni parassapadasaññāni honti. taṃ yathā? ti anti, si tha, mi ma.

46828.meaning1: practicing like the sages of old

46829.meaning2: deed done in the former existence

examples.text: sammajjanī padīpo ca, udakaṃ āsanena ca, uposathassa etāni, pubbakaraṇan'ti vuccati.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

46831.commentary: (ANa) pubbakāraṃ karotī'ti dān'ādikaṃ kusalakiccaṃ paṭhamataraṃ karoti. (ANa) tattha ca pubbakāraṃ karotī'ti tesaṃ bāhirānaṃ titthiyānaṃ datvā pacchā bhikkhūnaṃ deti.

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? assaddho hoti, dussīlo hoti, kotūhalamaṅgaliko hoti, maṅgalaṃ pacceti no kammaṃ, ito ca bahiddhā dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesati, tattha ca pubbakāraṃ karoti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakacaṇḍālo ca hoti upāsakamalañ'ca upāsakapatikuṭṭho ca.
yo ca pubbakārī, yo ca kataññū katavedī. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve puggalā dullabhā lokasmin'ti.

46834.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of pubbakāla

46835.commentary: (VINa) cattāro pubbakiccāti sammajjanī padīpo ca udakaṃ āsanena cā'ti idaṃ catubbidhaṃ pubbakaraṇan'ti vuccatī'ti vuttaṃ. chandapārisuddhiutukkhānaṃ bhikkhugaṇanā ca ovādo'ti ime pana cattāro pubbakiccā'ti veditabbā. (JAa) pubbakiccan'ti purimaṃ upakāraṃ.

examples.text: chandaparisuddhi, utu'kkhānaṃ, bhikkhugaṇanā ca, ovādo, uposathassa etāni, pubbakiccan'ti vuccati.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: kiṃ saṅghassa pubbakiccaṃ? pārisuddhiṃ āyasmanto ārocetha, pātimokkhaṃ uddisissāmi, taṃ sabb'eva santā sādhukaṃ suṇoma manasi karoma.

46837.commentary: (SNa) saṃsāro'ti khandhādīnaṃ avicchinnappavattā paṭipāṭi. pubbā koṭi na paññāyatī'ti purimamariyādā na dissati. yadaggena c'assa purimā koṭi na paññāyati, pacchimā'pi tadaggen'eva na paññāyati, vemajjhe'y'eva pana sattā saṃsaranti.

examples.text: saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa upaṭṭhitassatino samāhitacittassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ evaṃ pajānissati, anamataggo kho saṃsāro. pubbakoṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.

46838.meaning1: name of a bathing place outside Sāvatthī

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, āyām'ānanda, yena pubbakoṭṭhako ten'upasaṅkamissāma gattāni parisiñcitun'ti.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbakoṭṭhake.

seyyathā'pi, rāhula, pathaviyā sucim'pi nikkhipanti, asucim'pi nikkhipanti, gūthagatam'pi nikkhipanti, muttagatam'pi nikkhipanti, kheḷagatam'pi nikkhipanti, pubbagatam'pi nikkhipanti, lohitagatam'pi nikkhipanti, na ca tena pathavī aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā.
manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃva vahato padaṃ.
ye'me, bho gotama, puggalā… sāmaññe anapekkhavanto sikkhāya na tibbagāravā bāhulikā sāthalikā okkamane pubbaṅ'gamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā… na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.

46844.meaning1: old practice; former habit; old ways; previous conduct
46844.commentary: (THa) pubbaciṇṇaṃ idāni maṃ tvaṃ pahāya attano purimāciṇṇaṃ mah'icchat'ādiṃ paṭipajjasi, kiṃ nām'etan'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: app'icchatā sappurisehi vaṇṇitā, makkhappahānaṃ vūpasamo dukhassa, itissu maṃ citta tadā niyuñjasi, idāni tvaṃ gacchasi pubbaciṇṇaṃ.

46845.commentary: (SNa) pubbajo'ti paṭhamaṃ jāto kāṇo vā'pi hotu kuṇiādīnaṃ vā aññataro, yo paṭhamaṃ jāto, ayam'eva putto imissā devatāya vāde seṭṭho nāma hoti.

examples.text: khattiyo dvipadaṃ seṭṭho, balībaddo catuppadaṃ, komārī seṭṭhā bhariyānaṃ, yo ca puttāna pubbajo'ti.
bhikkhunī upasampajja, pubbajātim'anussariṃ, dibbacakkhu visodhitaṃ, vimalaṃ sādhubhāvitaṃ.

46847.meaning1: previous state of existence; previous incarnation

examples.text: nanu te, sāriputta, channena bhikkhunā sammukhā'y'eva anupavajjatā byākatā'ti? atthi, bhante, pubbajiraṃ nāma vajjigāmo. tatth'āyasmato channassa mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulānī'ti.

46849.commentary: (VINa) pubb'aṇṇanissitan'ti pubb'aṇṇaṃ nissitaṃ sattannaṃ dhaññānaṃ viruhanakakhettasāmantā ṭhitaṃ. es'eva nayo apar'aṇṇanissit'ādīsu'pi. (NIDD2) pubb'aṇṇaṃ nāma sāli vīhi yavo godhumo kaṅgu varako kudrūsako
46849.notes: Rice, paddy, barley, wheat, millet, legumes and sawa millet.

examples.text: sārambhaṃ nāma… pubb'aṇṇanissitaṃ vā hoti, apar'aṇṇanissitaṃ vā hoti, abbhāghātanissitaṃ vā hoti, āghātananissitaṃ vā hoti, susānanissitaṃ vā hoti, uyyānanissitaṃ vā hoti
bījabījaṃ nāma, pubb'aṇṇaṃ, apar'aṇṇaṃ, yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi atthi bīje jāyanti, bīje sañjāyanti, etaṃ bījabījaṃ nāma.

46850.meaning1: situated in (a field growing) primary grains
46850.commentary: (VINa) pubb'aṇṇanissitan'ti pubb'aṇṇaṃ nissitaṃ sattannaṃ dhaññānaṃ viruhanakakhettasāmantā ṭhitaṃ. es'eva nayo apar'aṇṇanissit'ādīsu'pi.

examples.text: sārambhaṃ nāma… pubb'aṇṇanissitaṃ vā hoti, apar'aṇṇanissitaṃ vā hoti, abbhāghātanissitaṃ vā hoti, āghātananissitaṃ vā hoti, susānanissitaṃ vā hoti, uyyānanissitaṃ vā hoti
ye, bhikkhave, sattā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, supubb'aṇho, bhikkhave, tesaṃ sattānaṃ.
āyasmā'pi kho rāhulo pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
imasmiṃ'y'eva pubb'aṇhasamaye ariyadhammaṃ āharissāmi samāharissāmi adhigacchissāmi phassayissāmi sacchikarissāmī'ti cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati. evam'pi alīnacitto akusītavutti.

46853.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of pubbaṇhasamaya
46853.construction:
pubba + aṇha + samaya + aṃ
pubbaṇhasamaya + aṃ

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā kismiñci'd'eva pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇāmetvā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya kapilavatthuṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
atha kho bhagavā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya yena kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa kamm'anto ten'upasaṅkami.

46855.synonym: pubba, pubbaka, purāṇa, purima, purimaka, porāṇa

examples.text: sīl'uttamā pubbatarā ahesuṃ, te brāhmaṇā ye purāṇaṃ saranti, guttāni dvārāni surakkhitāni, ahesuṃ tesaṃ abhibhuyya kodhaṃ.

46856.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of pubbatara
46856.meaning1: earlier; even before; previous to that
46856.commentary: (SNa) pubbe ca hi pubbatare ca santo'ti pubbe ca kassapabuddh'ādikāle pubbatare ca koṇāgamanabuddh'ādikāle, sabbe'pi vā ete pubbe ca pubbatare ca santo nāmā'ti.

examples.text: saddhā hi dānaṃ bahudhā pasatthaṃ, dānā ca kho dhammapadaṃ'va seyyo, pubbe ca hi pubbatare ca santo, nibbānam'ev'ajjhagamuṃ sapaññā'ti.

46858.meaning1: elder god; primaeval deity; more ancient god; i.e. asura
46858.commentary: (SNa) pubbadevā'ti devaloke ciranivāsino pubbasāmikā, tumhākaṃ tāva paveṇiāgataṃ bhaṇathā'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, sakko devānam'indo vepacitti asur'indaṃ etadavoca, tumhe khv'ettha, vepacitti, pubbadevā. bhaṇa, vepacitti, gāthan'ti.
pubbadevatā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ… taṃ kissa hetu? bahukārā, bhikkhave, mātāpitaro, puttānaṃ āpādakā posakā imassa lokassa dassetāro'ti.

46860.meaning1: front half; fore-part; upper part; torso

examples.text: sīhapubb'addhakāyo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

46861.commentary: (ANa) pubbanimittato passanto puññ'āpuññavasena uppajjitu'kāmassa atthassa vā anatthassa vā pubbanimittabhūtaṃ supinaṃ passati bodhisattamātā viya puttapaṭilābhanimittaṃ, kosalarājā viya soḷasa supine, ayam'eva bhagavā bodhisattabhūto ime pañca mahāsupine viya cā'ti.

examples.text: ayya sumedhatāpasa, porāṇakabodhisattānaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, pāramiyo vicinissāmā'ti nisinnakāle yāni pubbanimittāni nāma paññāyanti, tāni sabbāni'pi ajja pātubhūtāni

46862.commentary: (DNa) pubbanimittan'ti āgamanapubbabhāge nimittaṃ sūriyassa udayato aruṇ'uggaṃ viya. tasmā idān'eva brahmā āgamissati, evaṃ mayaṃ jānāmā'ti dīpayiṃsu.

examples.text: brahmuno h'etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ pātubhāvāya, yadidaṃ āloko sañjāyati, obhāso pātubhavatī'ti.

sūriyassa, bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ, aruṇ'uggaṃ. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamayāya etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi.

46863.commentary: (MNa) pubb'antan'ti purimakoṭṭhāsaṃ, atīta-khandha-dhātu-āyatanānī'ti attho. (SNa) pubb'antan'ti purimaṃ atītan'ti attho. (NIDD1a) pubb'anto vuccati atīto addhā'ti pubbasaṅkhāto anto koṭṭhāso atīto addhā'ti, atikkanto kālo'ti kathīyati.

examples.text: api nu tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā pubb'antaṃ vā paṭidhāveyyātha, ahesumha nu kho mayaṃ atītam'addhānaṃ, nanu kho ahesumha atītam'addhānaṃ, kiṃ nu kho ahesumha atītam'addhānaṃ
avijjāya nivuto loko'ti. avijjā'ti… pubb'ante aññāṇaṃ apar'ante aññāṇaṃ pubb'ant'āpar'ante aññāṇaṃ

46866.meaning1: theorizing about the past; speculating about the past
46866.commentary: (MNa) tattha atītakoṭṭhāsasaṅkhātaṃ pubb'antaṃ kappetvā vikappetvā gaṇhantī'ti pubb'antakappikā. pubb'antakappo vā etesaṃ atthī'ti pubb'antakappikā. evaṃ sesam'pi pubbe vuttappakāraṃ vuttanayen'eva veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubb'antakappikā pubb'ant'ānudiṭṭhino pubb'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhivuttipadāni abhivadanti.

46867.meaning1: regarding the past; concerning the past
46867.meaning2: regarding the past; concerning the past

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā pubb'antakappikā pubb'ant'ānudiṭṭhino pubb'antam'ārabbha anekavihitāni adhimuttipadāni abhivadanti, sabbe te imeh'eva aṭṭhārasahi vatthūhi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena, n'atthi ito bahiddhā.

46868.meaning1: associated with the past; connected with the past

examples.text: yathā ca te na byākātabbā, kiṃ vo ahaṃ te tathā byākarissāmi? katame ca te, cunda, pubb'antasahagatā diṭṭhinissayā, ye vo mayā byākatā, yathā te byākātabbā.

46869.meaning1: support for views associated with the past; foundation for opinions connected with the past

46870.meaning1: theory about the past; speculation about the past
46870.commentary: (SNa) pubb'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyo'ti pubb'antaṃ anugatā aṭṭhārasa diṭṭhiyo na honti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā pubb'ant'ānudiṭṭhīnañ'ca paṭinissaggā, apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhīnañ'ca paṭinissaggā, sabbaso kāmasaṃyojanānaṃ anadhiṭṭhānā, pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja viharati, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja viharāmī'ti. tassa sā pavivekā pīti nirujjhati.

46871.meaning1: with theories about the past; speculating about the past

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubb'antakappikā pubb'ant'ānudiṭṭhino pubb'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhivuttipadāni abhivadanti.

ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā pubb'antakappikā vā apar'antakappikā vā pubb'ant'āpar'antakappikā vā pubb'ant'āpar'ant'ānudiṭṭhino pubb'ant'āpar'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhimuttipadāni abhivadanti, sabbe te imeh'eva dvāsaṭṭhiyā vatthūhi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena, n'atthi ito bahiddhā.

46874.meaning1: theorizing about the past and the future
46874.meaning2: theorizing about the past and the future

examples.text: imehi kho te, bhikkhave, samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubb'antakappikā ca apar'antakappikā ca pubb'ant'āpar'antakappikā ca pubb'ant'āpar'ant'ānudiṭṭhino pubb'ant'āpar'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhimuttipadāni abhivadanti dvāsaṭṭhiyā vatthūhi.

46875.meaning1: seeing the beginning and the end

46876.meaning1: with theories about the past and the future
46876.meaning2: with theories about the past and the future

examples.text: imehi kho te, bhikkhave, samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubb'antakappikā ca apar'antakappikā ca pubb'ant'āpar'antakappikā ca pubb'ant'āpar'ant'ānudiṭṭhino pubb'ant'āpar'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhimuttipadāni abhivadanti dvāsaṭṭhiyā vatthūhi.

46877.meaning2: name given to 7 kinds of cereals such as rice, wheat

46879.commentary: (DNa) so ca nesaṃ pubbapuriso'ti so okkāko rājā etesaṃ pubbapuriso. n'atthi etesaṃ gahapativaṃsena sambhedamattam'pī'ti.

examples.text: tadagge kho pana ambaṭṭha sakyā paññāyanti, so ca nesaṃ pubbapuriso.
nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lok'akkhāyikaṃ samudd'akkhāyikaṃ itibhav'ābhavakathaṃ iti vāti

kuto, bho sāriputta, amhākaṃ appamādo yesaṃ no… mitt'āmaccānaṃ mitt'āmaccakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ñātisālohitānaṃ ñātisālohitakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, atithīnaṃ atithikaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, pubbapetānaṃ pubbapetakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, devatānaṃ devatākaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, rañño rājakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi kāyo pīṇetabbo brūhetabbo'ti?

46881.meaning1: talk about the departed; discussion about ghosts

examples.text: itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lok'akkhāyikaṃ samudd'akkhāyikaṃ itibhav'ābhavakathaṃ iti vā.

46882.meaning1: obligation to the previously departed; responsibility to the deceased
46882.commentary: (MNt) ñātakabhūtapubbā pettivisayaṃ upagatā pubbapetā, dakkhiṇeyyesu kālena kālaṃ dānaṃ datvā tesaṃ uddisanaṃ pubbapetakaraṇīyaṃ, petabalī'ti attho.

examples.text: kuto, bho sāriputta, amhākaṃ appamādo yesaṃ no… mitt'āmaccānaṃ mitt'āmaccakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ñātisālohitānaṃ ñātisālohitakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, atithīnaṃ atithikaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, pubbapetānaṃ pubbapetakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, devatānaṃ devatākaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, rañño rājakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi kāyo pīṇetabbo brūhetabbo'ti?

46883.meaning1: offerings to the previously departed; offerings to deceased ancestors

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, gahapati, ariyasāvako uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sed'āvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi pañcabaliṃ kattā hoti, ñātibaliṃ, atithibaliṃ, pubbapetabaliṃ, rājabaliṃ, devatābaliṃ. idam'assa tatiyaṃ ṭhānagataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.
tadāha sabbaññuvaro mah'esī, ānandabhaddaṃ madhurassarena, ye pubbabuddhesu kat'ādhikārā, aladdhamokkhā jinasāsanesu.
pubbabyañjanaṃ sarato puthakkātabbaṃ.

46888.meaning1: preliminary part; initial stage; beginning section

examples.text: tañ'hi pādakajjhānassa paccayo hoti. passaddhī'ti darathapaṭippassaddhi. sā hi appanāpubbabhāgassa sukhassa paccayo hoti.

46889.meaning1: first to speak; initiating conversation; affable
46889.commentary: (DNa) pubbabhāsī'ti bhāsanto ca paṭhamataraṃ bhāsati, tañ'ca kho kālayuttaṃ pamāṇayuttaṃ atthanissitam'eva bhāsati, na niratthakakathaṃ.

examples.text: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo ehisvāgatavādī sakhilo sammodako abbhākuṭiko uttānamukho pubbabhāsī…

46891.meaning1: in the first and last part of the night; in the late evening and early morning
46891.commentary: (VINa) pubbaratt'āpararattan'ti rattiyā pubbaṃ pubbarattaṃ, rattiyā aparaṃ apararattaṃ, paṭhamayāmañ'ca pacchimayāmañ'cā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pubbaratt'āpararattaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvan'ānuyogaṃ ananuyutto āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanto'ti?
indriyesu guttadvārā bhavissāma, bhojane mattaññuno, jāgariyaṃ anuyuttā, vipassakā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ, pubbaratt'āpararattaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ, bhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharissāmā'ti.

46892.meaning1: (gram) form of the previous letter; previous sound

examples.text: 443, 449. pubbarūpañ'ca.
sabbehi dhātūhi yapaccayo pubbarūpam'āpajjate vā. vuḍḍhate, phallate, dammate, sakkate, labbhate, dissate.
kālena kālañ'ca vaṇaṃ dhoveyyāsi, kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpeyyāsi, mā te na kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhovato na kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpato pubbalohitaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ pariyonandhi.
mayañ'hi bahussutamānaṃ uppādetvā catuppadikagāthāya'pi atthaṃ na jānāmā'ti nihatamānā pubbasadisam'eva ācariyassa vattappaṭipattiṃ katvā saggaparāyaṇā ahesuṃ.

46897.meaning1: previously; in the past; in the old days

examples.text: sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bho gotama, pubbakānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ, pubbassu'daṃ ayaṃ loko avīci maññe phuṭo ahosi manussehi, kukkuṭasaṃpātikā gāma-nigama-rājadhāniyo'ti.
nanu te, sāriputta, channena bhikkhunā sammukhā'y'eva anupavajjatā byākatā'ti? atthi, bhante, pubbavijjanaṃ nāma vajjigāmo. tatth'āyasmato channassa mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulānī'ti.
